sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरो दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् ।आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा ।। ७.२८.२९ ॥
transliteration: etasminnantare śūro daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān ।āruroha rathaṁ divyaṁ nirmitaṁ viśvakarmaṇā ।। 7.28.29 ॥

translations.english: At that very moment, the brave and mighty Dashagriva (Ravana) ascended a divine chariot that had been crafted by Vishvakarma.
